question: In the SPIKES protocol, the clinician should deliver prognostic information first and then assess what the family already knows about the patient's condition.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is false. In SPIKES, Perception (finding out what the family already knows) comes before Knowledge (providing new information). Delivering information without first assessing baseline understanding leads to miscommunication.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this is false. SPIKES specifically places Perception (P — what the family already knows) before Knowledge (K — giving information), so that information is calibrated to their baseline understanding.
